instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging program. Fuel cost is primarily pass-through under capacity purchase agreements with major airline partners (United, Delta, American, Alaska and others). SKYW bears fuel risk only on pro-rate operations.

warnings: Fuel cost is primarily pass-through to major airline partners under capacity purchase agreements. Contracts with major partners obligate partners to bear majority of economic risk of fuel price fluctuations. No hedging program.

throughput.source_quote: Estimated: fuel expense $97,899K / $0.97 per gallon = ~100.9M gallons. Item 7: 'the average price of fuel decreased 5.8% per gallon to $0.97 from $1.03.'
